text: Oh, that's hella a lot of herbivorous monsters...
They seem to be heading up the mountain...\nI wonder what they're doing...
Oh, I forgot. They're dangerous to the Eumanos.\nWell, let's follow them quietly then!
What just happened??\nWhere did those monsters go?
!! Everyone hold your weapons and gather in one\nplace!!
It's my fault...My friends got taken away because\nof me!!
You should stop crying!\nJust look at that!!
I knew something was wrong when your friends were\nattacked...Because normally those monsters would\neat the Eumanos immediately after attacking right?
But this time they just kidnapped them.\nThat means something must be controlling them and\nit makes them forget their behavior.
They're still alive! I guess they're using them\nto lure us, so the're not gonna kill them right\naway. We need to hurry!!
I've grown to understand what the bad guys might\nbe thinking since traveling with you.
Tch, why am I only getting better at things like\nthis? It's so useless for a merchant...\nC'mon, let's go!!
They're definitely heading to the summit.\nLet's hurry!
